about.body: The AJ200D is a Inline-4 (I4), 2.0L (1,999 cc), Diesel engine used across Jaguar's 3 model range, in production 2015–present. We rebuild every AJ200D to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The AJ200D is fitted across E-Pace, F-Pace, XE — see the full applications table above for exact variants, generations and years.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ200D is fitted across multiple Jaguar models, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation and specification. We confirm by registration or VIN before quoting or supplying anything.
